title: The cycle-class map
mathematical_role: Distinguish codimension-p algebraic cycles with rational coefficients, their cycle classes, the rational Hodge-class target, possible information loss, and the conjectural general converse.
learning_objective: Read the established direction from algebraic cycles to rational (p,p) classes separately from the open surjectivity statement of the Hodge conjecture.
literal_semantics: The algebraic domain is labelled Z^p(X) ⊗ Q.
The map is explicitly labelled cl^p.
The cohomological target is explicitly labelled H^{2p}(X,Q) ∩ H^{p,p}(X).
The established direction from algebraic cycles to rational (p,p) classes is distinguished from a dashed/open converse.
nonliteral_semantics: The drawn ellipses are generic cycle tokens, not specific subvarieties of a named X.
Multiple arrows merging into one class illustrate possible information loss without asserting a particular kernel.
Box sizes and multiplicities encode no dimensions.
The diagram asserts neither injectivity nor general surjectivity.

notes: The successor is a theorem-bound conceptual diagram; it does not instantiate a worked variety or compute cohomology.

accessibility.alt_text: Codimension-p algebraic cycles with rational coefficients map by the cycle-class map into rational Hodge classes; possible information loss is shown, and the reverse general surjectivity direction is marked open.
accessibility.long_description: The left box is Z^p(X) tensor Q with schematic codimension-p cycle tokens. An arrow labelled cl^p points to a box labelled H^{2p}(X,Q) intersect H^{p,p}(X). Merging schematic paths indicate that different cycles can map to the same class. A lower section labels the algebraic-to-Hodge direction established and the rational converse open, with an explicit statement that neither injectivity nor general surjectivity is asserted by the diagram.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Pedagogical exposition of the established cycle-class direction and the location of the conjectural rational-surjectivity converse.
not_claimed: A proof of the Hodge conjecture
